questions.question: 1 350 learners go on a trip in buses that seat 65. How many buses are needed? Explain the remainder.
questions.expected_answer: 1 350 ÷ 65 is 20 remainder 50. The 50 learners still need seats, so one more bus is needed: 21 buses.

questions.question: Thabo and Lindiwe share R2 400 in the ratio 1 : 3. How much does each get?
questions.expected_answer: There are 1 + 3 = 4 parts. R2 400 ÷ 4 = R600 per part. Thabo gets R600 and Lindiwe gets 3 × R600 = R1 800. Check: R600 + R1 800 = R2 400.

questions.question: Which is better value: 6 juices for R54 or 4 juices for R40? Show your working.
questions.expected_answer: R54 ÷ 6 = R9 per juice and R40 ÷ 4 = R10 per juice. The pack of 6 is better value because each juice costs less.
